## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`packages/core/test/` or `packages/mcp/test/`)
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] If this touches `examples/` or `templates/`: `npm run examples:check` passes, and I looked at every rendered PNG before committing it — `check` passing isn't the same as looking right
- [ ] If this adds or changes a format: the size/limits/zones come from the platform's own official docs, with the URL in `source` (or it's `verified: false` with a note on what I checked)
- [ ] Docs updated for anything user-visible (README, the affected package's README, skill `references/*.md`, MCP tool description) — see CONTRIBUTING.md "Docs follow code"
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## Unreleased`
- [ ] No new native dependency (or, if there is one, it's justified in this description and in the commit message)
